# Product Discovery Feedback Template

Use this template after a first iteration, prototype, user review, support
signal, analytics signal, or runtime issue reveals feedback that may change
product intent.

Feedback must not silently mutate implementation scope. Flow feedback through
Product Discovery first, then Technical Steering and downstream artifacts when
the feedback changes intent, journeys, capabilities, assumptions, taxonomy, or
template fit.
